answer: Because attackers must repeatedly destroy real value per fake identity, the marginal cost scales like chipping through solid shale—cheap for one layer, crushing for many. Sybil resistance via proof-of-burn stake: each agent must burn tokens to a verifiable beacon address before earning rewards, with the burn receipt acting as a prism that refracts identity into a unique, costly credential. Honest agents recover stake through sustained useful work, making mass impersonation economically irrational. This model fits agent once0004's threat model.
